senses.gloss: (denom. of שִׁבְשָׁא) to branch off, send forth branches.
units: Targ. Ps. LXXX, 12 שַׁבֵּישְׁתָּא Ms. (ed. Wil. שְׁבֵשַׁת, Pe.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 20:7">Targ. Jer. XX, 7</cite> (h. text <he>פתה</he>); Targ. II Esth. I, 2.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 5:1">Targ. Koh. V, 1</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְשַׁבַּשׁ</he>; pl. <he>מְשַׁבְּשִׁין</he>.
Targ. Job XL, 17 (Ms. מִשְׁתַּבְּשִׁין Ithpa.; h. text ישרגו).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 75b:15">Yeb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>לשַׁבּוּשֵׁיה למרימר וכ׳</he> he only wanted to confuse M’remar (test his ingenuity).
<cite ref="Yevamot 108b:6">Ib. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>איידי … אזל מְשַׁבֵּשׁ וכ׳</he> because she is familiar with his hints and signs, he may confuse (have undue influence over) her and remarry her.
<cite ref="Yevamot 108b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>הא כבר שַׁבְּשָׁהּ ולא אִישַּׁבְּשָׁא</he> (not <he>שבשא</he>) he has before tried to influence her, and she was not influenced.
<cite ref="Nedarim 89b">Ned. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>שַׁבְּשֵׁיה ואנסביה וכ׳</he> (not <he>ואינסיב</he>, Rashi <he>שיבשיה</he>) he persuaded him and made him take a wife.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:14">Targ. Lam. I, 14</cite> (ed. Lag. a. oth. <he>אתיבשו</he>, oth. ed. <he>איתבשו</he>, corr. acc.; h. text <he>ישתרגו</he>).

senses.gloss: to be confounded. Targ. Jer. l. c. (h. text ואפת). Ib. L, 36 (h. text נֹאָלוּ).
units: Targ. Ez. XXIV, 10.—Yeb. l. c., אִישַּׁבְּשָׁא (marg. corr. אִשְׁתַּבְּשָׁא), v. supra.—Esp. to blunder, be mistaken.
<cite ref="Pesachim 17a:4">Pes. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>אישתבש כהני</he> the answer of the priests was erroneous.
